hooks.command: if jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -q 'git push'; then cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}" 2>/dev/null; if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"build"' package.json; then set -o pipefail; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -5; EXIT=$?; set +o pipefail; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Build failed — fix TypeScript errors before pushing"}'; fi; fi; fi

if jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -q 'git commit'; then cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}" 2>/dev/null; LOG=$(mktemp); ERR=""; if ! bun run format:check >"$LOG" 2>&1; then ERR="Format check failed — run: bun run format"; elif ! bun run lint >"$LOG" 2>&1; then ERR="Lint failed — run: bun run lint:fix"; elif ! bun run build >"$LOG" 2>&1; then ERR="Build failed — fix TypeScript errors"; fi; if [ -n "$ERR" ]; then jq -n --arg e "$ERR" --rawfile l "$LOG" '{decision:"block",reason:($e + "\n\n" + ($l|.[-1500:]))}'; fi; rm -f "$LOG"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running format + lint + build before commit...
